info.name: List or found Trouble Ticket objects

params.name: externalId
params.description: ID given by the consumer and only understandable by him (to facilitate his searches afterward)

params.name: priority
params.description: The priority (ITIL) is based on the assessment of the impact and urgency of how quickly the Ticket should be resolved as evaluated by the Buyer. The Priority is used by the Seller to determine the order in which Tickets get resolved across Buyers.

params.name: sellerPriority
params.description: The priority (ITIL) is based on the assessment of the impact and urgency of how quickly the Ticket should be resolved after evaluation by the Seller of the impact of the Issue on the Buyer.

params.name: severity
params.description: The severity or impact (ITIL) of the Ticket as evaluated by the Buyer.

params.name: sellerSeverity
params.description: The severity or impact (ITIL) of the Ticket on the Buyer as evaluated by the Seller.

params.name: ticketType
params.description: The presumed cause of the Trouble Ticket as evaluated by the Buyer.

params.name: status
params.description: The current status of the Trouble Ticket

params.name: observedImpact
params.description: The type of impact observed by the Buyer.

params.name: relatedEntityId
params.description: ID of a related entity that this ticket is related to and is present in the `relatedEntity` list

params.name: relatedEntityType
params.description: Type of a related entity that this ticket is related to and is present in the `relatedEntity` list

params.name: creationDate.gt
params.description: The date on which the Trouble Ticket was created - greater than

params.name: creationDate.lt
params.description: The date on which the Trouble Ticket was created - lower than

params.name: expectedResolutionDate.gt
params.description: The date provided by the Seller to indicate when the Ticket is expected to be resolved - greater than

params.name: expectedResolutionDate.lt
params.description: The date provided by the Seller to indicate when the Ticket is expected to be resolved - lower than

params.name: resolutionDate.gt
params.description: The date the Ticket status was set to resolved by the Seller - greater than

params.name: resolutionDate.lt
params.description: The date the Ticket status was set to resolved by the Seller - lower than

params.name: buyerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as the a Buyer. MUST be specified in the request only when the requester represents more than one Buyer.

params.name: sellerId
params.description: The unique identifier of the organization that is acting as the Seller. MUST be specified in the request only when responding entity represents more than one Seller.

params.name: offset
params.description: Requested index for start of resources to be provided in response

params.name: limit
params.description: Requested number of resources to be provided in response
